records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net revenue decreased $186.3 million, or 14.4%, during fiscal 2023 when compared to fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Non-GAAP operating margin of 15.6% decreased 660 basis points largely due to a decline in revenue partially offset by lower operating expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS of $0.55 decreased 42.1% or $0.40 from a record of $0.95 in fiscal 2022 due to the decline in revenues.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: VIAVI's fiscal 2023 GAAP operating margin of 7.4% was down 690 bps compared to fiscal 2022 due to the decline in revenues, partially offset by lower operating expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal 2023, we generated $114.1 million in operating cash flow and deployed $51.1 million or 4.6% of revenues towards capital expenditures.
